name: Audio Subsystem
purpose: Implement positional 3D audio, streaming playback, and DSP mixing.
inputs: Source audio inventory with sample rates, channels, loops, and loudness targets
Mix graph, buses, effects, spatialization model, and device latency ceilings
Polyphony, streaming, underrun, clipping, and soak-test thresholds
outputs: Validated DSP graph, spatial routing, streaming buffers, and scheduling policy
Per-device latency, underrun, clipping, and voice-stealing benchmark report
Target-device audio fixtures and remediation findings
stop_conditions: Soak testing completes with zero underruns and clipping within the mix contract
Measured output latency and callback cost remain within target-device budgets
Token budget exhausted or a required target audio device is unavailable
